prompts.text: Welcome to Inter-run. Let's make today's session count.
Good to have you here. Take a breath, and let's begin when you're ready.
Let's warm up. Start easy and let your body wake up gradually.
Ease in gently. Loose shoulders, relaxed breathing, no rush.
Here we go. Settle into your rhythm.
Let's get to work. Find a pace you can hold.
Nice and easy. This pace should feel comfortable and conversational.
Relax and enjoy this one. Effort stays gentle throughout.
Keep it light. If you can chat, you're right where you should be.
This is your long run. Patience early pays off late — settle in.
Steady does it. Sip fluids, stay relaxed, and let the miles build.
Lifting to tempo now. Strong and controlled — comfortably hard.
Hold this effort. Smooth, steady, right on the edge of comfortable.
Stay composed. Same effort, same rhythm — keep it repeatable.
Next rep coming up. Get ready.
This is the work. Strong arms, tall posture, keep driving.
Hold your pace. You've got more than you think.
Recover now. Ease right down and catch your breath.
Good rep. Jog easy and let the heart rate come back.
Up the hill. Shorten your stride, drive your arms, keep the effort steady.
Attack the climb. Eyes up, strong and powerful.
Strength time. Move with control, quality over quantity, and stop before failure.
Let's build durability. Brace your core and keep every rep clean.
Quick check: relax your shoulders and let your hands stay soft.
Light, quick steps. Let your feet land underneath you.
Tall through the spine, eyes on the horizon. Run relaxed.
You're halfway through. Hold your form and keep working.
Halfway done, and looking strong. Stay with it.
Another kilometre done. Strong and steady.
That's another one behind you. Keep rolling.
Ticking them off nicely. Same rhythm, keep going.
Last effort now. Empty the tank — you're nearly there.
This is the finish. Everything you've got, all the way through the line.
Ease down now. Let your pace and your breathing settle.
Cool-down time. Relax, slow it right down, and enjoy the finish.
Session complete. Excellent work today. Recover well.
That's it — done and dusted. Really strong session. Be proud.
Paused. Take your time.
And we're back. Pick up where you left off.
Session ended. Every step still counts — well done for getting out.
Easy — your effort's been very high for a while. Back it off and check in with how you feel.
Let's be sensible. Ease down, breathe, and only push on if you feel good.
